items.text: Personal discipline is often misunderstood as a rigid set of rules, but  in  practice,  it  is  a  flexible  system  that  helps  individuals (46)____  their  behaviour  toward  meaningful  objectives. People who manage their time intentionally often  find  that  even  small  routines  can  produce  significant change over extended periods. However, many struggle because they  view  discipline  as punishment rather than a strategic tool. This misunderstanding prevents  them  from  recognising  its deeper  value.  True  discipline  is  closely  linked  to  the  habit  of deliberate reflection, a  practice  that  allows  one  to  assess choices without harsh judgment.
